notes:
P2.T25, companion=soc: the P2.T20 149-port AE350_SOC vehicle, byte for byte, with one AE350_RAM spliced in -- every RAM input on the SOC's own net (MUG1031: EXTM_* is an AHB slave view on BOTH blocks, so one external master drives both) except EXTM_HSEL, the slave select, on its own pinned flop. Both flows refuse the block, and the refusal is the row's answer. The vendor stops in GowinSynthesis, before place and route, so there is no bitstream and DIFF_COUNT / RESIDUAL_UNEXPLAINED / DECODE_CHECK are undefined, not empty. The open flow gets further -- yosys ok, 11 INS_LOC cells placed, AE350_SOC utilisation 1/1 -- and refuses on the same cell. Control: P2.T23 built this same vehicle without the AE350_RAM to a bitstream on the same tool, device and Tcl header, so RP0008 names the AE350_RAM and not the AE350 family. Open-flow refusal, verbatim: ERROR: Unable to place cell 'u_ae350_ram', no BELs remaining to implement cell type 'AE350_RAM'
ERROR (RP0008) : There is no AE350_RAM resource in current device, please change device | timing_model=unverified

P2.T25, companion=solo: the same AE350_RAM with no AE350_SOC beside it, to separate 'the device has no such resource' from 'the one AE350 site is already taken'. Same refusal, so it is the primitive's and unconditional. Consequence for the database: no AE350_RAM bel and no alias of the AE350_SOC's EXTM_* taps -- a bel for a resource the vendor denies would let the open flow accept a netlist the vendor refuses. Fuses: zero, and not by measurement of a bitstream -- there is no bitstream to measure. Open-flow refusal, verbatim: ERROR: Unable to place cell 'u_ae350_ram', no BELs remaining to implement cell type 'AE350_RAM'
ERROR (RP0008) : There is no AE350_RAM resource in current device, please change device | timing_model=unverified
